pages.image_type: black-and-white video surveillance-style frame with reticle overlay
pages.description: A grainy grayscale image resembling a targeting or sensor display. A white crosshair reticle is centered, with a long vertical line and a horizontal line marked at each end with the numeral '3'. Two small dark dots appear near the center-right, just above the horizontal reticle line. The top of the frame has a large solid black rectangular bar (redaction). Several additional black rectangular bars are positioned on both the left and right sides at three vertical levels, partially overlapping lighter gray patches. A timestamp reading '12/31/99 18:20:22' appears in the lower-left corner. The background has a uniform noisy gray texture.
